h: The Waters of the Rock and Torah Within the Heart

p: וַיְדַבֵּר ה׳ אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר (בְּמִדְבַּר כ, ז–ח)
for he was commanded to take it himself.
and afterward "and you shall bring forth" and "you shall give drink"
Also the word "before their eyes" is superfluous,
for it should have said "before them"
(as the Ramban, of blessed memory, pointed out);
and two letters, yud-hei, are superfluous.
Also, what it says, "and it shall give its water"
it should have said "and it shall give water."
"Because you did not believe in Me"
to say of Moshe and Aharon
that they would not believe, Heaven forbid!
was he not commanded, "Take the staff,"
and presumably to strike with it?
that the main intent of this command
was that he instill the power
of his Oral Torah into Yisrael,
as he handed it to Yehoshua afterward;
which refers to the Oral Torah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קלז, ב)
so he was commanded to shine into all Yisrael
the power of the Oral Torah.
And this is what it says, "And He spoke, etc., saying":
מוֹרֶה עַל בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
indicates the aspect of the Oral Torah:
"saying" in a whisper, in the heart,
"and you shall say in your heart"
And this is the main reason the Torah is likened to water,
which leave a high place, etc.,
which refers to the Oral Torah.
referring to a worthy student and an unworthy one.
And likewise the well was in the merit of Miriam,
and the well alludes to the Oral Torah;
and David is the middah of Malchus,
and Malchus is the mouth, the Oral Torah;
וּבְאֵר הוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and the well is the root of the Oral Torah.
And this is what it says, "and assemble the congregation":
alludes to the alef, the Supernal Wonder,
and the tav, from the World to Come.
for Aharon, who is the groomsman of the Queen,
הוּא יַשְׁפִּיעַ בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
will impart the aspect of the Oral Torah
from the power of Moshe Rabbeinu, alav hashalom,
And this is why it says "vedibartem":
which indicates the World to Come,
And this is the meaning of "before their eyes":
that is, that they impart into the heart of Yisrael;
depend on the understanding of the heart"
And the letters yud and hei,
and it will be closed forever,
so that the holiness remain forever.
שֶׁמּוֹרֶה עַל מַדְרֵגַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
this indicates the level of the Oral Torah
which is from the upper yud,
which shines into the letter vav;
And this is why it says "and you shall give drink":
that Moshe Rabbeinu would be the one who gives drink.
tav, from the World to Come,
that he shine from his level into the congregation.
that is, that even into the animals of Yisrael
he impart the aspect of water from the root,
so that the eating be in holiness;
שֶׁהוּא שַׁמְנוּנִית שֶׁל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
which is the richness of the Oral Torah;
"They ate fat meat at Rava's house";
"Here is a table and here is meat, etc."
And this is what it says, "and their animals":
that he instill holiness into them
so that the eating be words of Torah.
to shine into them from his own level;
and this is what it says (Bamidbar 20:9),
the tip of the yud above,
which precedes the entire Name Havayah.
And this is what it says (Bamidbar 20:11),
what is above the grasp of the intellect;
in instilling into the heart of Yisrael
the power of his Oral Torah
at the level of Moshe Rabbeinu,
וְאַף שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה עַל יְדֵי קִלְקוּלוֹ
And although it was not through his own failing,
but rather the generation was not worthy,
And about this it was said to him,
"Because you did not believe in Me"
that you did not instill into the heart of Yisrael
"to sanctify Me before the eyes of Bnei Yisrael"
that is, to instill into the heart of Yisrael;
for this is what "before the eyes" indicates,
since "the vessels of the eye depend on the heart,"
And here they are called "Bnei Yisrael,"
for it was necessary that Yehoshua bring them
and he would distribute to them
the holiness of the Oral Torah,
שֶׁעַל זֶה מוֹרֶה קְדוּשַּׁת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל
which is what the holiness of Eretz Yisrael indicates:
which is the arrangement of Eretz Yisrael"
and that is the holiness of the Oral Torah.
and He was sanctified through them":
that Moshe and Aharon would not enter
that they would die in the wilderness,
through this they merited the holiness
that would enter in Eretz Yisrael into the heart;
and this is what the word "bam" indicates:
that the two holinesses were closed
And it is not as a punishment but as counsel:
since they did not then merit
through the waters of the well,
they would merit that the holiness enter them
through His executing judgment upon those sanctified to Him.
And this is "and He was sanctified through them,"

paragraphs.text: Source: Taanis 7a — “ואמר רבי חנינא בר אידי: למה נמשלו דברי תורה למים, דכתיב: ״הוי כל צמא לכו למים״, לומר לך: מה מים מניחין מקום גבוה והולכין למקום נמוך, אף דברי תורה אין מתקיימין אלא במי שדעתו שפלה.” — “And Rabbi Ḥanina bar Idi said: Why are matters of Torah likened to water, as it is written: “Ho, everyone who thirsts, come for water” (Isaiah 55:1)? This verse comes to tell you: Just as water leaves a high place and flows to a low place, so too, Torah matters are retained only by one whose spirit is lowly, i.e., a humble person.”
